observation.happening: A floating dark overlay during a Google Meet call is showing an AI-generated live meeting memo, auto-sorted into 決まったこと(decided)/懸念(concerns)/やること(todo)/質問(questions), each line stamped with a timestamp and speaker name.
observation.most_important: The categorized live memo content itself — the value proposition of the widget.
observation.next_action: Click 会議の横に開く to pop the panel out beside the call, switch to 字幕/Ask Astra tabs, or hit the red button to stop recording.
anomalies: The three right-most icons (eye, pause, stop) carry no labels or visible tooltips, so their function must be guessed from icon shape alone
No visible scrollbar or indication of how many more memo items exist beyond 質問

ai_look: Auto-bucketing transcript lines into 決まったこと/懸念/やること/質問 is now a very common template across AI meeting-note tools (Granola, Fireflies, Otter) rather than a distinctive take
FBBE.why: Clean dark UI, real hierarchy via section labels + timestamps + speaker tags, calm palette — but the categorization pattern and icon-only right-side controls are a step behind the polish of the best-in-class tools (labels/tooltips, more distinctive visual treatment of categories).

observation.happening: Same overlay widget's header/toolbar, captured at the very start of a recording (00:00), before any memo content exists — only the record-status row and tab row are present.
observation.most_important: 録音中 status with 00:00 timer confirming the session has just begun.
observation.next_action: Switch to メモ/字幕/Ask Astra tabs (currently empty/inactive), or press pause/stop.
anomalies: No content region visible below the toolbar at all — can't tell if an empty-state message would appear once a tab is opened, or if this is simply cropped to the header strip
Same unlabeled eye/pause/stop icon row as FBBE, with no active-tab highlight visible on メモ/字幕/Ask Astra to show which (if any) is selected

FD1D.why: This frame only shows the toolbar chrome shared with FBBE at t=0; it doesn't reveal how the widget handles the zero-content state (empty-state copy, tab selection affordance), which is needed to judge it against best-in-class products.
